items.text: Thank you for your continued support of EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS. We would like to inform you of the contents of the update.
Fixed an issue in Online Play where sinking the ball with the “Mega Cup” setting enabled could cause the player to appear to be in an unplayable position from other players' perspectives.
Fixed an issue where the ball could become caught on the pin or flag and become unplayable when using Yuna's or Lilith's Special Mode.
Adjusted COM decision-making to reduce instances of behavior such as repeatedly hitting the ball O.B. under certain conditions.
Fixed several other minor issues.
Jasmine and Yuna are now available from the start.
Eased the requirements for unlocking the World Tour for Gloria, Silvia, L.J., and Stuart.
Adjusted the requirements so that VS Challenges from the Semi-Pro through Platinum ranks can be attempted sooner.

Adjusted the “Points Match” Special Rule in Match Play so that when playing with this rule, the Shot Points for the current hole are displayed instead of the cumulative Shot Points.: We will continue to make fixes and adjustments to provide a more enjoyable gameplay experience.: Thank you for your continued support of EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS.
Thank you for your continued support of EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS. We would like to inform you of the contents of the update.
Fixed an issue in Scramble where the Fairway Hit and GIR statistics would not reach 100%.
Fixed an issue where forward/backward camera movement was unavailable when using Control Type 3 with camera settings other than "2/5".
Fixed several other minor issues.
Adjusted the overall difficulty of each episode in World Tour to provide a smoother progression experience.
Improved COM decision-making logic to reduce unnatural behavior, such as repeatedly hitting shots toward buildings.
When using the Traditional Shot setting, characters will now transition into their address animation at the start of a shot.

In online play, when another player switches to the Landing Point Camera, spectators will now automatically switch to the Landing Point Camera as well.: We will continue to make fixes and adjustments to deliver a more seamless experience.: We hope you continue to enjoy and support EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS.
Thank you for your continued support of EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS. We would like to inform you of the contents of the update.
Fixed an issue where tournament rankings were not displayed correctly after holing out in World Tour and Challenge Mode.
Fixed an issue where the displayed projected distance did not accurately match the actual shot distance when using the Special Mode of Warp Shot-type skills.
Fixed an issue where Approach Support would not function correctly when using the Pinhole or Magician's club/ball abilities.
Fixed several other minor issues.

Added a new shot gauge design with improved impact gauge visibility for both Traditional Shot and Gauge Shot.: *The new shot gauge can be enabled by selecting "Shot Gauge 2" under: System > Game Settings > Switch Shot Gauges
Adjusted the landing-point camera behavior in Approach Mode for Control Type 1 and Control Type 2 so that the camera faces the character's direction.
Adjusted the swing animation in Traditional Shot mode to appear more natural when performing low-power shots.
Adjusted the Control and Impact parameters of certain characters.
Removed collision detection from tee markers to prevent golf balls from colliding with them.
Adjusted the amount of trajectory variation applied by gear that affects ball flight.
Fixed an issue in Group Match where the cup-in result could become unplayable.
Fixed an issue on Hole 8 of the Euro Classic G.C. where the ball could become unplayable when rolling into a specific area of the green.
Fixed an issue in Colorful where the game could become unable to progress when moving to the next hole after the "Mega Cup’s" happening event occurred.
Fixed an issue where Super Backspin would sometimes fail to activate when the ball landed at a lower elevation than the cup.
Fixed an issue in certain World Tour episodes where unofficial rounds were incorrectly reflected in Course Scores.
Fixed an issue in Course Scores where "Fairway Hit Rate" was displayed as "100.0%" when viewing Overall scores for an unplayed tee setting.
Fixed an issue where play records shown in the Result Status Check screen were not displayed correctly in some cases.
Fixed an issue in Boom Golf where replaying an explosion event could sometimes produce a different result from the original play.
Fixed an issue where assigning the Impact Power Adjustment function to the same button as Shot Start in the control settings prevented power adjustment during impact.
Fixed an issue where the button used for "Skip Camera Presentation" in Control Type 3 did not match the button guide.
Fixed an issue in Control Type 3 where the controls for "Teerific Ticket" and "Declare Unplayable" overlapped.
Fixed several other minor issues.: We will continue to make fixes and adjustments to deliver a more seamless experience.: We hope you continue to enjoy and support EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS.
Thank you for your continued support of EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS. We would like to inform you of the contents of the update released on March 4, 2026.
*Please check the version displayed in the upper right corner of the title screen to confirm you are using the latest version.
Stopped Aya's trait "hates wet grass in the rough on rainy days" from activating outside the rough/semi-rough areas.
Fixed swing effects to prevent them from not displaying or displaying too long.
Resolved issues in World Tournament where the Rewards screen would not appear or the entry count would not reset correctly under certain conditions.
Fixed an issue in Group Match where the game would become unplayable when starting the round while the host is performing a shot motion in the lobby.
Implemented several other minor fixes.
Refined the club’s downward swing motion to make it smoother.
Adjusted the CPU difficulty balance for Chapter 1 of L.J., Rose, and Stuart in the World Tour.
Added an option to choose whether to play the World Tournament with other players or alone.
Changed online play settings to align all players' tee locations with the host's.
Implemented an option in online play to choose whether to replace disconnected players with CPU players or leave and close the room in case of connection issues etc.

Adjusted online play to award "Online Lvl EXP" based on scores and holes played in case of a sudden room closure.: We will continue to make fixes and adjustments to deliver a more seamless experience.: We hope you continue to enjoy and support EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS.

STEAM®: Ver 1.0.9
*Please check the version displayed in the upper right corner of the title screen to confirm you are using the latest version.
Fixed an issue where the caddie's voice would not play after the first shot.
Fixed an issue where the "True Devotion" and "Beyond the Final Chapter" trophies/achievements could not be obtained under certain circumstances.
Fixed an issue where the challenge acquisition cutscene would reappear after winning against VS2 in Challenge Mode.
Fixed an issue where Dino's episode 6 in World Tour would unlock under unintended conditions.
Fixed an issue where the wind would change when using "Redo Shot" in Training.
Adjusted some voice lines that occur during Alex's shots.
Fixed several other issues.
Adjusted the camera to switch more quickly to the ball trajectory view upon a Just Impact.
Adjusted the game to switch surrounding characters to a waiting state at the start of the shot.
Adjusted the game so that characters waiting behind the camera in the shot screen are transparent for improved visibility when they overlap with the camera.

Adjusted the game so that the club is raised to a position corresponding to the determined power value. *There is a minor issue with the effects during some shots, which will be fixed in the next update.

In Training, when using "Redo Shot," the direction from the previous shot is now saved so that you can retry multiple times in the same direction.: We will continue to make fixes and adjustments to deliver a more seamless experience.: We hope you continue to enjoy and support "EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS."
Thank you for your continued support of EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS. We would like to inform you of the contents of the update released on December 11, 2025.
STEAM®: Ver 1.0.8
*Please check the version displayed in the upper right corner of the title screen to confirm you are using the latest version.
Fixed progression stopping issues in World Tour.
Corrected an issue where COMs would behave incorrectly under certain conditions.
Implemented additional measures against cheating in World Tournament.
Fixed an issue where voices would not play correctly under certain conditions in Scramble Match.
Fixed a few other miscellaneous issues.: \
Improved the stability of COM behavior during the shot.
Optimized performance on courses during bad weather.
Adjusted Shot Type 3 to allow players to control the camera on the green.
Adjusted the game to ensure settings such as control type and shot system are saved upon game restart.
Adjusted online games to allow players to view some information about their opponent's play.
Adjusted "Solo Round" mode to allow Special Rule: Fair Play to be set.
Adjusted the number of players for "Aya Chapter 4," "Dino Chapter 4," "L.J. Chapter 2" and "Alex Chapter 5" in World Tour.

Adjusted the total number of holes to 18 for "Lin Chapter 6," "Sonia Chapter 7," and "Stuart Chapter 4" in World Tour.: We will continue to make fixes and adjustments to deliver a more seamless experience.: We hope you continue to enjoy and support "EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS."
Thank you for your continued support of EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS. We would like to inform you of the contents of the update released on November 27th, 2025.
STEAM®: Ver 1.0.7
*Please check the version displayed in the upper right corner of the title screen to confirm you are using the latest version.
\[Fixes and Adjustments]
Fixed the text display issue in "Challenge Mode" where some tournament names were illegible.
Fixed the issue where spectators could enter the teeing ground under certain conditions.
Adjusted caddie voice selection to avoid the repetition of the same lines.
Addressed the issue where changing the costume color to "Pitch Black" slowed character response.
Adjusted caddies' behavior when moving across the fairway.
Fixed the issue where PAC-MAN could disappear from the screen under specific conditions.
Fixed the issue where the selection of "Gale Club" and "Gale Ball" was not properly applied when equipped simultaneously.
Fixed the issue where shot points were displayed as "0" on the "World Tournament" ranking.

Corrected the colors of the crowns awarded for top 10 finishes in "World Tournament": Ranked in the top 10, 1 to 4 times: Bronze Crown: Ranked in the top 10, 5 to 9 times: Silver Crown: Ranked in the top 10, 10 times or more: Gold Crown

A fix for a security vulnerability found in games built with Unity as reported by Unity Technologies on October 3rd, 2025 (Fri).Please see the official announcement from Unity Technologies for further details.

Fixed a few other miscellaneous issues.: We will continue to make fixes and adjustments across all platforms to deliver a more seamless experience.: Thank you for your continued support of "EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS."
*Please check the version displayed in the upper right corner of the title screen to confirm you are using the latest version.
Readjusted the impact gauge input position and trajectory due to the influence of spin.
Fixed an issue where rounds could not be completed normally under specific conditions.
Fixed an issue where the game could become stuck on the loading screen when performing specific steps in VTR.
Fixed a rare issue in Jasmine: Episode 6 of World Tour where the game could become stuck after the COM declared an unplayable lie under specific conditions.

notes.title: We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.
